name: How should I prepare my bathroom before fixture installation begins?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my bathroom before fixture installation begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before the contractor arrives, clear all personal belongings from the vanity, countertop, medicine cabinet, and tub surround. Locate your home's main water shutoff valve in case individual fixture stop valves fail or leak during removal. You should also verify that the new fixtures have arrived intact, without cracked porcelain or missing installation components. Clearing a direct pathway from the home entryway to the bathroom protects your hallways and allows the crew to move tools and fixtures safely.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear out personal items, locate your main water shutoff valve, inspect new fixtures for damage or missing parts, and ensure a clear walking path for the work crew.
